audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit's Refuge (W) blocks ATTACKS in its zone. That means it eats your autos and your Crippling Strike reset, while Decimate — an ability — still lands. The entry never says which of your tools survive the zone, and the content layer never names a single Shen ability (packet defect).
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' The whole trade pattern is Q inside the zone, autos outside it, and that distinction appears nowhere.
audit.corrected: Stated, with Shadow Dash at 18/16/14/12/10s and Spirit's Refuge at 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Shadow Dash but gave no numbers.

audit.corrected: Real numbers for Shadow Dash, Spirit's Refuge and Apprehend.

edits.before: Your spike: Shen's sword-Q and E taunt are strong, but you out-trade him in lane — E him in, Q the edge and stack Hemorrhage. His Spirit Blade DPS doesn't beat your combo, so commit when his taunt is on cooldown.
edits.after: Your spike: Spirit's Refuge (W) blocks attacks, so your autos and the Crippling Strike reset die in the zone while Decimate lands through it. Q the edge inside, auto outside, and commit on Shadow Dash's 18s cooldown.

edits.before: Your spike holds — your R execute punishes Shen, whose only defensive tool is his shield-W. Land E-Q-W with stacks and Noxian Guillotine closes it before his shield can absorb enough.
edits.after: Your spike holds — Ki Barrier is one small shield per cast, and Noxian Guillotine is true damage on top of it. Land Apprehend, Q the blade and 5 stacks, and the execute closes before he can re-shield.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay Darius: E him in, Q-W with stacks and you out-DPS his Spirit Blade and shield. At 6 your R execute beats his single defensive shield, so play to shove hard and pressure his tower whenever his taunt is on cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay Darius: pull him out of the Spirit's Refuge zone before you auto, because it blocks attacks but never Decimate. At 6 your R beats one Ki Barrier shield, so shove and pressure his tower whenever Shadow Dash is on its 18s.

edits.before: Trade when his E taunt is down and Q the outer edge
edits.after: Trade on Shadow Dash's 18s cooldown; Q the outer edge

edits.before: Use E taunt and shield-W to survive and disengage trades
edits.after: Shadow Dash in, then Spirit's Refuge to blank your autos

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash (Taunt): matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash (Taunt): matchup-defining — 18s at rank 1, and the taunt walks you into his blade. Fight on it. - Spirit's Refuge: 16s at rank 1; it blocks attacks, so land Decimate inside the zone and save your autos for outside it. - Darius E (Apprehend): 26s at rank 1 — hold it to drag him off the blade or to break the Stand United channel, and keep Ghost for the run-down once the taunt is gone.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: His engage CC, 18s at rank 1. Until it is spent, every commit is a coin flip.

notes: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities: your autos and the Crippling Strike reset are eaten in the zone while Decimate lands through it. That is the trade rule for the whole lane and it was absent from all 17 fields. Chart disagreed with its own whys and the packet in three rows. The full layer writes the ability as 'Shadow Dash (Taunt)' in focus.text, loading, phases and breakdown — the same parenthetical-suffix pattern other slices reported; it cannot be cleaned inside the length band from here.
